name: ClinGen (dosage sensitivity, gene-disease validity, region curation)

version.value: Files regenerated daily (gene curation list dated 2026-10-25); recurrent CNV V2.1 since 2026-03-18

scope: Haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity scores for genes and genomic regions, recurrent CNV regions (V2.1), curated gene-disease validity, clinical actionability reports and assertions (adult and paediatric contexts) and the Evidence Repository export of variant pathogenicity classifications by Variant Curation Expert Panels.
identifiers: HGNC symbol and NCBI Gene ID
mapping_methods: Gene- and region-level; coordinates given for GRCh37 and GRCh38.

quantitative.summary: Categorical dosage scores (0-3, 30, 40) and validity classifications.

licence.name: ClinGen terms: curated content released openly, free to capture and use

coverage_limitations: Only genes and regions that have been through curation
known_omissions: Variant classifications other than those of the expert panels in the Evidence Repository export are in ClinVar and the ClinGen Allele Registry, not in these files

reuse_decision.rationale: Small, openly licensed and directly addresses dosage sensitivity and CNV interpretation; Open Targets carries only evidence_clingen gene-disease links.

mechanism_evidence.note: haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity scores for whole genes and regions

evidence_profile.biological_context: Expert-panel curation of whole genes and genomic regions: dosage sensitivity (loss or gain of an entire gene or region), recurrent CNV regions and gene-disease validity. Gene- and region-level assertions; recurrent regions are intervals.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Graded by curators from published cases. Dosage scores encode evidence levels; 30 stands for a gene associated with an autosomal recessive phenotype and 40 for dosage sensitivity unlikely. A curated judgement, not a measurement, and not allele-specific.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Moderate for the dosage mechanism of whole-gene or whole-region loss or gain. It says nothing about the mechanism of a particular small variant, and contiguous-gene or position effects of multi-gene CNVs are not separated.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: Curated association of dosage change (and, in the validity records, of gene disruption) with a named phenotype; penetrance and expressivity vary.
evidence_profile.absence_means: A gene or region without a record has not been curated, which differs from a score meaning no evidence (0) or dosage sensitivity unlikely (40). Absence is not evidence of dosage tolerance.
